Let $\beta>0$ and $n$ an integer. Using $e^{i\omega_n\beta}=-1$, where $\omega_n = (2 n + 1)\pi/\beta$ is a fermionic Matsubara frequency,
the imaginary-time integral of the phase factor is
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\beta} d\tau\, e^{i\omega_n\tau} = \frac{2i}{\omega_n} .
\label{eq:mats}
\end{equation}
